origin: The Robot Room, added 24 November 2026 at Steven Powell's direction. Grew out of the Java Young Robot Builders room and his audition of the Qwen AI Studio agent team, which proposed a nine-workshop robotics bundle. Deliveries were audited by driving the shipped code: Qwen's Motors was repaired under Steven's sanction (constants re-derived from a Mabuchi RF-370CA datasheet until Kt = Ke); Qwen's Control arrived with no simulation and was completed by Muse under his direction, its presets measured and two re-tuned so their labels are true; Qwen could not deliver Sensors, which Google Antigravity built and Muse repaired under sanction (heading fusion rewired to its own compass, PID relabelled P-control, ellipse and stereo FOV corrected). The remaining six workshops are Muse originals, each self-audited headlessly before integration. The collection copy is the maintained original; full provenance is in the project's COLLECTION.md and each lesson.
sourceType: original Everyday Cool workshop (multi-builder: Qwen, Google Antigravity, Muse)
